scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,ANGULAR" -c "cyan,yellow" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend-angular"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,ANGULAR" -c "cyan,yellow" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend-angular"
scripts.dev:angular: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,ANGULAR" -c "cyan,yellow" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend-angular"
scripts.dev:react: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,REACT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-react"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,ANGULAR,REACT" -c "cyan,yellow,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend-angular" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-react"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix frontend-angular && npm run build --prefix frontend-react
